text_simplified: Healthy nutrition and physical activity maintain body weight and heart health, and protect against diseases. It is preferable to use unsaturated oils instead of saturated fats, and to consume vegetables, fruits, and whole grains. One should drink sufficient water and engage in daily exercise. Balance between food and movement protects against obesity and illnesses.
